fact: The Attorney General's Office annual report 2024 (Warbixin Sannadeedka 2024, a regular annual report; a 2021 one also exists) publishes statistics from its own case records: 4,375 files registered in 2024 across federal and member state offices, 2,917 of them at the national office, with 4,908 accused by type of crime for 2023-2024, drawing on prosecution records and police referrals.
title: WARBIXIN SANNADEEDKA 2024
publisher: Xafiiska Xeer Ilaaliyaha Guud ee Qaranka
